
Unlike most of the web sites you have probably visited, this site can be edited by you, the user.

How?  Well, this site (which is a [http://tikiwiki.org/tiki-index.php iki], a type of [http://wiki.org/wiki.cgi?WhatIsW Wiki]) has facilities to allow you to edit its pages from the comfort of your very own browser.

If you are seeking admin help, try the [[Lojban IRC|Lojban IRC]] channel.
